package.name: biguasim_main
package.description: Core simulation bridge for BiguaSim: owns the biguasim.make(...) environment, ticks it, publishes per-agent sensor topics, and accepts per-agent control commands. Structural port of holoocean_main (Node / Interface / Encoders pattern) adapted to BiguaSim's real Python API. Originally authored in the biguasim-ros2-develop repo (package biguasim_main by mgmateus); merged here to sit alongside biguasim_bridge / biguasim_sensor_check / biguasim_bringup.
